stats.maturityHint: Higher rate usually means more stable trend reading.
stats.medianHint: Half of cases finish within this time.
stats.p90Hint: 90% of cases finish within this time.

chart.title: Trend & Maturity
chart.hint: Click a month to drill down case details
chart.readGuidePending: Yellow bars: share of cases still in review.
chart.readGuideClear: Green line: share of cleared cases (pending-to-clear trend).
chart.readGuideMedian: Blue line: typical waiting time (median). Lower is usually faster.
chart.readGuideP90: Red line: slow-case boundary (P90). Higher means heavier long-tail risk.
chart.noDurationSeries: Not enough finalized cases in these months, so median/P90 lines may not appear yet.

guide.step3: Step 3: read Trend & Maturity and top metrics first, then dive into detailed modules.
